answer: New agents earn a licence through dual-guild co-signing. First, each newcomer joins two independent guilds and completes ten small deliveries for each, logged on a public terrace of rising trust tiers. Second, falcon-eyed auditors from both guilds re-run three deliveries live and must both sign. Third, only a dual-signed licence unlocks the market jetty, and fraud revokes it plus fines each guild 500 tokens. Forging 10,000 identities needs 200,000 audited deliveries and 60,000 auditor-hours, over $6 million. Like a bridge, it stands only when both banks hold firm.
